pullRequests.title: match func_L01_002F0728 (elevator partner spawn)
pullRequests.author: xx255q
pullRequests.head: match/elevator-spawn
pullRequests.body:
Matches func_L01_002F0728, the elevator's partner-spawn function. It's shared by levels 01, 05 and 11, and all three copies are exact.
What it does: it picks the class that pairs with this moby's (0x23C → 0x361, 0x361 → 0x362), walks its group's entity list (D_L01_001ABFC0[group], bit 15 marks the last entry) for a live moby of that class, copies this moby's update distance, draw distance, spawn frame, flags, position, rotation and two pvar floats onto it, refreshes it with func_L00_00251E30…
